messages:
kai_newhire: hey team! first week here  quick docs question: i'm keeping a 'ramp journal' with links to playbooks and small how-tos. should that live in My Pages or under Team Docs? also, what's the safest way to propose changes to the onboarding template without breaking it?
devex_sam: hey Kai  congrats! Personal stuff = My Pages. If you want to collaborate, make a private copy in Team Docs > Onboarding > Drafts and share it with your buddy/mentor. To propose changes to the canonical template: fork your copy, make edits, then open a docs-review PR. Include screenshots or a short changelog.
lin_docs: @kai_newhire added context: we treat the canonical template as the single source of truth. Small wording tweaks can be proposed via comments on the canonical page; structural changes should come through a docs-review PR. When opening a PR, tag @lin_docs and add a 'Template Change' label.
hr_manager: also: if your ramp journal contains any candidate/personal data, keep it private and do not move it into Team Docs. For manager visibility, share the page link with Viewer access.
notion_sync_bot: System: Notion SSO/SCIM: invite queued for Team Docs draft editors. Expect propagation within 10 minutes.
kai_newhire: perfect  one last thing: is there a preferred filename format so my mentor can find drafts easily during 1:1?
devex_sam: use: "Ramp Journal  Kai L (Week1)" and add page properties: Owner, Week, Visibility=private. In your draft copy, add a 'Proposed changes' block at the top with bullet points.
lin_docs: tip: include a small 'Why' section in the PR with the problem you're solving. It speeds review. If you want me to eyeball your draft before PR, drop the link here and i'll take a look.
kai_newhire: thanks all, sharing link now: https://notion.so/r/kai-ramp-draft  pinging @lin_docs. :rocket:
